theme: Making qubits that must talk be adjacent
title: Place the Interaction Graph First: Qubit Routing on a Branchy Coupling Graph
strategies: identity mapping, always detour every routed pair through a fixed anchor physical qubit, never checks for cancelling gates (trivial)
identity mapping, true shortest-SWAP-path per gate, no cancellation -- locally optimal every single step, never revisits the layout (greedy / the trap)

interaction-graph-weighted initial placement (seed the densest logical pair on a real coupling edge, then greedily place the rest by weighted distance to what's already placed) + shortest-path routing + exact gate-cancellation on planted repeat pairs (strong)
joint mapping+routing search / lookahead SWAP insertion that also reorders cancellation opportunities across non-adjacent windows (open ceiling, uncovered)
